symptoms.label: Paid rides remain as outstanding debt
symptoms.root_cause: The app or driver record fails to reflect completed online, cash, or split payments, so the user sees a balance and may be blocked from booking. Reconcile payment records with trip status and clear the debt once a valid payment is confirmed.

symptoms.label: A single ride triggers duplicate payment
symptoms.root_cause: The passenger pays through the app and also pays the driver, forgets the selected online method, or is charged more than once electronically. Prevent second collections after online payment and refund verified duplicate charges.

symptoms.label: Unexpected fare increases or lost change
symptoms.root_cause: The final amount rises through recalculation, unauthorized fees, route changes, or change the driver keeps. Compare the final fare with the quote and route, block unauthorized surcharges, and return any missing change.

symptoms.label: Ride disruptions leave charges unresolved
symptoms.root_cause: A ride left active or canceled without completion can still generate a fare, and later promised corrections may not reach the account. Close or cancel disrupted rides accurately and ensure the resulting refund or debt correction is applied.

dropped_causes.label: Driver refuses the selected online method
dropped_causes.description: The driver refuses card or online payment and insists on cash although the app retains the original online charge.

dropped_causes.label: Driver-caused waiting-time surcharge
dropped_causes.description: A waiting or start-time fee is added when the driver arrives late, starts the trip late, or records waiting before reaching the passenger.
